map.A 成本 12 / 售价 38 → 毛利 26 元、毛利率 68.4%；B 成本: A cost 12 / price 38 → gross profit 26 CNY, margin 68.4%; B cost 18 / price 48 → gross profit 30 CNY, margin 62.5%; C cost 25 / price 58 → gross profit 33 CNY, margin 56.9%. Totals: revenue 144 CNY, cost 55 CNY, gross profit 89 CNY, blended margin 61.8%. C has the highest gross profit (33 CNY) but the lowest margin; if it also sells the most, the blended margin is pulled below 61.8%, so its cost or price should be optimized first.
map.毛利率和毛利额看哪个？: Should I look at gross margin or gross profit?
map.看结构用毛利率（反映定价与成本控制），看贡献用毛利额（反映实际赚多少）。低毛利额: Use gross margin for structure (it reflects pricing and cost control) and gross profit for contribution (it reflects what you actually earn). A low-profit high-margin dish does not make money; a high-profit low-margin dish may be the real profit driver - judge both together with sales volume.
